description:
Repackage of org.eclipse.microprofile.jwt:microprofile-jwt-auth-api:2.2 with an
        explicit module-info.class (name: org.eclipse.microprofile.jwt). The official API
        provides neither a module-info nor an Automatic-Module-Name, which prevents its use with jlink.
        This artifact is the single source of the MP JWT 2.2 spec consumed by the
        Cervantes modules; the official TCK runner keeps using the original API.
